fields.description: Human region label shown in the console, e.g. Mumbai, India.
fields.label: Display Name

fields.description: Infrastructure provider hosting this region, shown as the pin's brand mark. Display vocabulary only — distinct from Atlas's Server.provider_type (DigitalOcean/Scaleway/Self-Managed/Fake); reconcile into a shared source if provider identity ever needs to be authoritative.
fields.label: Provider
fields.options:
AWS
Hetzner
Frappe
OCI
DigitalOcean
Scaleway
Self-Managed
Fake

fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. IN. The console derives the flag emoji from it.
fields.label: Country Code

fields.description: Region latitude for the console world map. 0/0 keeps the region off the map (it still lists).
fields.label: Latitude

fields.description: Region longitude for the console world map.
fields.label: Longitude

fields.description: Numeric region ID from Atlas Settings, from 0 to 65535. Leave blank until the operator confirms it.
fields.label: Atlas Region ID

fields.description: Base URL of the regional Atlas, e.g. https://blr.atlas.example.com. Blank until an operator connects this region to one.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Wildcard zone the regional proxy serves, without the leading *., e.g. par-2.fc.frappe.dev. Leave blank until the operator confirms it; one-click Open stays unavailable until it is set.
fields.label: Proxy Domain

fields.description: The last signed Atlas tenant API check succeeded. A generic ping is not sufficient.
fields.label: Reachable

fields.description: Shared secret reserved for signed regional state delivery.
fields.label: Webhook Secret

fields.description: Registered means the host collected its tokens and is running.
fields.label: Cargo Status

fields.description: Where this region's Cargo site is served, e.g. http://10.0.0.5:8000. Blank until an operator connects this region to a Cargo host.
fields.label: Cargo Base URL

fields.description: Signs this region's Cargo service reports. Central checks every delivery against it. Set automatically when the host enrols.
fields.label: Cargo Webhook Secret
